summary: Cross Country Healthcare filed an 8-K disclosing the expiration of the HSR Act waiting period for its merger with KL Criss Cross Intermediate, LLC (Parent) and its advisor, with Merger Sub merging into the Company. Terms: The filing does not state per-share price or premium. The HSR waiting expired June 22, 2026, satisfying a major condition. The merger is expected to close in Q3 2026; a special shareholder meeting is set for July 16, 2026. Mechanics: The locums division will be sold to All Star Healthcare Solutions, an affiliate of Parent. Watch for shareholder vote and remaining customary closing conditions; risk-arb spread will depend on final merger price and regulatory clearance.
